description: SINOE ® - Répartition des tonnages de DMA collectés par type de collecte is published by ADEME. The table separates municipal waste tonnage by residual, separate-collection and collection-centre channels. Its stated coverage is France; department-level odd-numbered survey years from 2009. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. Collection-channel totals should not be added to overlapping waste-type totals. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
